knowledge.title: Authentication hardening
knowledge.text: Use MFA, login throttling, and account-aware rate limits. Review successful logins following failures. Avoid permanent lockouts that enable denial of service.

knowledge.title: Security logging
knowledge.text: Record authentication failures and authorization errors. Restrict access to logs, exclude credentials and tokens, and correlate events with accurate timestamps.

knowledge.title: Incident response
knowledge.text: Validate the incident, preserve evidence, scope affected assets, apply proportionate containment, and document recovery and lessons learned.

rules.title: Brute-force login attempt
rules.description: Five or more failed logins from one source to one asset within ten minutes.
recommendations: Check the targeted accounts and any successful logins that followed.
Apply account-aware throttling and verify MFA coverage.
Validate source ownership before considering a temporary access restriction.

rules.title: Possible password spraying
rules.description: Failed logins targeting five or more distinct usernames from one source to one asset within ten minutes.
recommendations: Review all targeted accounts for subsequent successful authentication.
Reset credentials only for accounts with evidence of compromise.
Review MFA, rate limits, and identity-provider risk signals.

rules.title: Successful login after repeated failures
rules.description: A successful login follows five or more failures for the same username, source, and asset within ten minutes.
recommendations: Confirm the login with the account owner and review session activity.
If unauthorized, revoke the affected session and follow credential recovery procedures.
Review authentication controls and preserve the related events.

rules.title: Repeated unauthorized access
rules.description: Three or more access denials from one source to one asset within ten minutes.
recommendations: Confirm the expected permissions with the service owner.
Review requested resources and neighboring authorization events.
Correct misconfigurations or investigate unauthorized probing.

rules.title: Privilege escalation detected
rules.description: An explicit privilege escalation event is recorded. This can also represent authorized administration.
recommendations: Check the elevation against approved administrative activity.
Review the account, process, and permissions involved.
If unauthorized, contain the affected account or asset through your incident response process.

rules.title: Unusual outbound transfer
rules.description: A recorded outbound transfer is at least 100 MB. Volume alone does not establish exfiltration.
recommendations: Confirm the destination, data classification, and business purpose.
Correlate with network flow and application audit logs.
Preserve evidence and contain the transfer only if unauthorized activity is confirmed.
